thread:
maria_support: Customer reports their org’s monthly token bucket showed 0 at 06:03 local TZ despite expecting refill at 00:00 local. They hit 429s and are in a rush for a demo. Customer pasted their payload: 

customer_jk: 'We were at 0 tokens at 06:03. Demo scheduled at 07:00 — why didn't it refill at midnight? Our account timezone is CET. Sample header: `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0`, `x-reset-ts: 1700000000`. Can you confirm?'

sam_engineer: Quick check — our platform refills monthly buckets at 00:00 UTC. We only convert to tenant TZ for UI display. If they expect midnight CET, that will be offset.

maria_support: Customer insists they saw refill previously at their local midnight. Could caching cause the UI to show 0 for hours?

sam_engineer: Yes, possible. UI uses a 5m cache for quota displays plus browser cache. But a 6-hour discrepancy suggests something else. Two things to confirm: is the org suspended/paused (billing) and did they have a big spike before midnight?

josh_billing: If the org is suspended (manual or due to failed billing), we mark tokens as frozen — they won't auto-top up until suspension is cleared. However, suspended accounts usually see an explicit status in the billing dashboard and get a `account:suspended` flag in the admin API. This is separate from the normal monthly refill.

alex_prod: Also check for a rollover bug we saw in staging with DST boundary for CET last year. Unlikely but possible. Can you ask for org_id + tenant timezone + a sample request_id from one of the 429 responses? With that we can run an audit query quickly: 

```
-- admin query to fetch quota history (run in admin console)
SELECT timestamp, event, remaining_tokens
FROM quota_events
WHERE org_id = '<ORG_ID>'
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR)
ORDER BY timestamp ASC;
```

sam_engineer: Also request the customer to run a quick curl against the public API to capture headers: 

```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage
```
and paste the `x-reset-ts` and `x-rate-limit-remaining` values.

customer_jk: Provided org_id: org_83b9, timezone: Europe/Prague, sample request id: req_01H2XQZ4. Attached screenshot of UI showing 00:00 local last month and 06:03 this month.

maria_support: Thanks — forwarding to eng + billing. Will keep customer updated.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy to console-service completed at 2024-11-04T05:58:00Z (commit: a1b2c3). No rollback triggered.

sam_engineer: Good to know — no recent quota code deploys. I'll run the audit query with org_83b9 and check refill event timings and suspension flags.

josh_billing: I pulled org_83b9 — billing shows a payment method failure on 2024-10-31 23:50 UTC and a temporary auto-suspend at 2024-10-31 23:55 UTC. That would block refill at 00:00 UTC on 2024-11-01 until payment is resolved. Customer may have seen previous months when payment succeeded.

alex_prod: That explains the 06:03 observation: if they tried requests after suspension, the UI could show 0 and then later a webhook or payment retry cleared suspension and tokens were restored — timeline mismatch. We should verify webhook/payment retry timestamps against quota events.

sam_engineer: Confirmed via admin query: refill event did not occur at 2024-11-01T00:00:00Z for org_83b9 due to `account:suspended`. A `suspension_cleared` event exists at 2024-11-01T06:01:12Z followed by a `quota_replenish` at 2024-11-01T06:01:15Z.

maria_support: Replying to customer now: explain UTC refill, suspension prevented automatic refill, show timeline (suspension at 23:55 UTC, cleared at 06:01 UTC, replenish at 06:01 UTC). Offer to manually top-up for demo and provide steps to reconfigure payment method.

customer_jk: Please top us up for the demo — sending new card details now. Much appreciated.

josh_billing: I'll do a one-time credit top-up to unblock the demo and follow up with billing steps. Noting for audit: top-up + payment update.

maria_support: Resolution plan: 1) billing tops up immediately, 2) customer updates payment method to avoid future suspensions, 3) eng will document DST/suspension interplay in our support KB. Marking this thread as support->billing->eng follow-up. :thumbsup:
